However, the instructions allow the deduction only if 'You, or your spouse if filing jointly, aren't claimed as a dependent on someone else's... 2025 tax return.' rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; restatement accepted. Line 9 is the worksheet's arithmetic, which the restatement gives as printed; the conditions of i1040gi p. 98 ('You can take this deduction only if all of the following apply') are applied after it, on Schedule 1 line 21: sli.eligible requires a status other than married filing separately and sli.claimed false, where sli.claimed asks 'Are you, or your spouse if filing jointly, claimed as a dependent on someone else's ... 2025 tax return?', and sli.allowed enters zero otherwise, which sli.deduction and s1.line21 read. A filer, or a spouse on a joint return, claimed as a dependent gets no deduction.
